predictions.rationale: The Agency class is central to the cognitive architecture, which includes the design critics. It manages the execution of critics in the background.
The Critic class is the base class for all critics, which analyze the design and suggest improvements. It is a core component of the design critics feature.
The ToDoList class manages the list of issues and suggestions generated by the critics. It is essential for tracking and displaying the results of the design critics.
The ToDoItem class represents individual issues or suggestions generated by the critics. It is a fundamental component for managing and displaying critic results.
The ToDoPane class provides the user interface for displaying the list of issues and suggestions from the critics. It is crucial for the user interaction with the design critics.
The ActionAutoCritique class provides the action for automatically running the critics. It is part of the user interface for triggering the design critics.
The ActionOpenCritics class provides the action for opening the critics view. It is part of the user interface for accessing the design critics.
The ActionResolve class provides the action for resolving issues. It is part of the user interface for managing critic results.
The ActionSnooze class provides the action for snoozing issues. It is part of the user interface for managing critic results.
The ActionNewToDoItem class provides the action for creating new issues. It is part of the user interface for managing critic results.
